snippet.title: Rockhounds - Gameplay video
snippet.description: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player co-op extraction ARPG featuring ruthless mercenaries, volatile planets, and the galaxy’s greediest Megacorps. You are a Rockhound: a merc hired to raid dangerous worlds for the universe's most absurdly valuable fuel: Space Coal. As the Megacorps grow hungrier for profit, they’ll pay anything to secure their stash, even if it means sending you into the most hostile environments ever discovered. While the rest of humanity falls apart, you’re busy with the only thing that matters: Getting rich.
